_comment: Upstream design-pattern tracker for leiverkus/research-superpowers (MIT). Native to theology, biblical archaeology and digital humanities; ERC borrows workflow-harness patterns only (SOFT-GATE override audit, focus-driven ingest, methodology-aware gates, skill-as-source-of-truth contract). No code or prompts are copied. Humanities-specific skills, the hermeneutic methodology as-is, OpenCode/MCP integrations and keyed services are excluded.
name: research-superpowers
label: research-superpowers
policy: design-pattern-only; no code or prompt copying; humanities-specific content, OpenCode/MCP integrations and keyed services are excluded
last_audit_note: Initial baseline from docs/concepts.md, docs/skill-contract.md and the repository tree; hooks/drift_check.py, docs/source-classes.md, docs/skill-pressure-testing.md and docs/phase-flow.md were not read line by line, so they stay candidates, not adopted patterns.

adopted_patterns.note: ERC already had researcher gates with --force and a required note; added the waived conditions (unmet) to the run ledger and a wiki_lint warning when more than 30% of the last 10 gate passes were forced. Native rewrite, report-only.

ingest-source reads a source under an explicit focus (project research question by default) and appends a per-focus section on re-ingestion instead of creating a duplicate card; focus is optional so existing cards stay valid.

candidate_patterns.idea: Declare the project's methodology and adapt stage requirements (for ERC: causal-empirical, structural/theory, descriptive, mixed; results that deviate from the analysis plan are marked exploratory)
candidate_patterns.status: candidate; needs a design pass because it changes stage gates

candidate_patterns.idea: Skill is the only procedural source of truth; agent files declare implements/skills and the dispatch contract; skills declare inputs/outputs; a deterministic lint checks the contract
candidate_patterns.status: candidate; verify Claude Code skills-preloading in official docs first, and mind that installed vaults carry user edits to agent files

candidate_patterns.idea: Grade sources (journal, working paper, official statistics, aggregator or reposted copy) and flag weak ones during review
candidate_patterns.status: candidate; read upstream docs/source-classes.md before designing

candidate_patterns.idea: Scenario tests that check whether a skill resists shortcuts under pressure
candidate_patterns.status: candidate; any LLM-backed run consumes quota and only runs on explicit request

explicitly_excluded.reason: Domain content for humanities research; ERC is economics
Host integrations and keyed or external services; ERC stays keyless and uses refmgr for reference managers
